text.text_excerpt: Today is the first day of summer and WATS is done with until fall- leaving us to actually pay for our amazing music for a while. Wednesday at the Square (Lafayette Sq) is so special. It is super awesome that the shows are all free (i know, crazy!), the bands are all super good (I finally got to see Galactic here!), and the people all come together really well to have a good time. Feel free to bring a chair or blanket or just wander around on foot. You'll see families with small children all the way up to older folks enjoying themselves every Wednesday afternoon. Another wonderful way to enjoy some FREE live music in a smoke-free environment, but this time on a Wednesday evening, downtown at Lafayette Square. The line up is consistently Stellar. The food selection includes a nice variety of stuff for all eating styles. For libations, you get a wide range of options like, beer, iced coffee, wine & cocktails, daiquiris, plus sodas and water. But you HAVE to hit the ticket booth first!! ($4 for an abita, and $5-8 for the food choices.) There is a small arts market set up on the opposite side from the music giving you a FULL-ON festival experience. Wednesday at the Square is an awesome event, especially if you work in the CBD. It starts right after most people finish work, and there is plenty of food and drinks. The music acts are usually pretty good, and it's FREE to get in! They only ask that you don't bring outside food and drink because concession sales help fund the concerts. I'm more than happy to oblige.
